# Asset files

How a robot is stored on disk: **URDF** (ROS, tree of links) vs **MJCF** (MuJoCo XML: compiler, defaults, actuators, sensors, keyframes). Motrix `load_model` accepts MJCF, URDF, or USD. We will author **one MJCF** and load it in both simulators.

Mesh paths, compiler flags, and “inertia from geom” belong here — not in the control loop.
For *what* those meshes and geoms mean (visual vs collision, convex hulls, validation),
see [Geometry and collision](geometry-and-collision.qmd#geometry-and-collision) first.

## Menagerie vendor assets {#menagerie-vendor-assets}

Tutorial examples use robots from [MuJoCo Menagerie](https://github.com/google-deepmind/mujoco_menagerie)
(**`agilex_piper`**, **`arx_l5`**). We do **not** commit their meshes to this repo.

| Committed | Not committed (local only) |
|---|---|
| `third_party/menagerie.lock.json` — repo URL, git ref, folder list | `third_party/mujoco_menagerie/` — sparse checkout |

```bash
bash scripts/fetch_menagerie_assets.sh   # clone / update vendor tree
uv sync --extra mujoco
uv run python -c "
import mujoco as mj
m = mj.MjModel.from_xml_path('third_party/mujoco_menagerie/agilex_piper/scene.xml')
print('piper ngeom', m.ngeom)
"
```

Load **`scene.xml`** (includes robot + ground), not the bare `piper.xml` / `arx_l5.xml`,
unless you are editing the model. Mesh paths inside Menagerie MJCF are relative to each
robot folder’s `assets/` directory.

Doc figures under `docs/imgs/menagerie/` are **generated PNGs** (committed so the static
site builds without MuJoCo). Regenerate with
`scripts/render_menagerie_geometry_figures.py` (visual, convex hull of visual meshes,
and collision columns) — see
[Geometry and collision](geometry-and-collision.qmd#inspect-in-the-viewer).

*(To fill: `<compiler meshdir="…"/>` for our own MJCF; `motrixsim.load_model` parity.)*
